main_measure.name: Mean 20-bar forward return after forecast > 0 minus mean 20-bar forward return of all bars, non-overlapping blocks, pooled
main_measure.threshold: excess > 0 with t >= 2 confirms; excess < 0 with t <= -2 rejects; else inconclusive; fewer than 30 blocks with forecast > 0 is inconclusive

supporting_check.name: Share of positive 20-bar forward returns when forecast > 0 minus unconditional share

decided_by: The t-statistic lies between -2 and 2, so the result is inconclusive.
reading: Situation is last_history_value > 0 with forecast > 0; blocks start at positions 0, 20, 40, ... of each window with the full 20-bar return inside the window; the comparison group is all grid blocks of all coin-windows pooled, tested with Welch t; the supporting check passes when the conditional hit rate exceeds the unconditional one.
